notes: Here, on means open and off means closed. The two independently hinged upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately as required; their individual opening order and nearly simultaneous closing are less certain because of the wide-angle viewpoint and 8-frame sampling.
scene_description: A user surveys a studio apartment and sequentially opens and closes a coat closet, several kitchen appliances and storage components, a refrigerator/freezer, and a laundry closet.
